+"""Build group decorators without importing Click."""
+
+import typing as t
+
+__all__ = ["group_invoke_empty"]
+
+_Callback = t.Callable[..., t.Any]
+_Command = t.TypeVar("_Command")
+_CommandFactory = t.Callable[..., t.Callable[[_Callback], _Command]]
+
+
+@t.overload
+def group_invoke_empty(
+    command_factory: _CommandFactory[_Command],
+    Group: type,
+    name: _Callback,
+    cls: type | None = None,
+    **attrs: t.Any,
+) -> _Command: ...
+
+
+@t.overload
+def group_invoke_empty(
+    command_factory: _CommandFactory[_Command],
+    Group: type,
+    name: str | None = None,
+    cls: type | None = None,
+    **attrs: t.Any,
+) -> t.Callable[[_Callback], _Command]: ...
+
+
+def group_invoke_empty(
+    command_factory: _CommandFactory[_Command],
+    Group: type,
+    name: str | _Callback | None = None,
+    cls: type | None = None,
+    **attrs: t.Any,
+) -> _Command | t.Callable[[_Callback], _Command]:
+    """Create a group that runs without a subcommand by default.
+
+    Pass a callback as ``name`` to decorate it immediately. Otherwise, return
+    the decorator from ``command_factory``. Use ``Group`` when ``cls`` is ``None``.
+    """
+    if cls is None:
+        cls = Group
+
+    attrs.setdefault("invoke_without_command", True)
+
+    if callable(name):
+        return command_factory(cls=cls, **attrs)(name)
+
+    return command_factory(name, cls, **attrs)

+import runpy
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+from unittest.mock import sentinel
+
+import pytest
+
+import click
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_group_invoke_empty.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def group_invoke_empty():
+    return runpy.run_path(str(MODULE_PATH))["group_invoke_empty"]
+
+
+def test_import_without_click():
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-S", str(MODULE_PATH)], check=True)
+
+
+def test_bare_callback_dispatch(group_invoke_empty):
+    class Group:
+        pass
+
+    callback = Mock()
+    decorate = Mock(return_value=sentinel.group)
+    factory = Mock(return_value=decorate)
+
+    assert group_invoke_empty(factory, Group, callback) is sentinel.group
+    factory.assert_called_once_with(cls=Group, invoke_without_command=True)
+    decorate.assert_called_once_with(callback)
+    callback.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", [None, "", "named"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("invoke_without_command", [False, None])
+def test_configured_dispatch(group_invoke_empty, name, invoke_without_command):
+    class CustomGroup(click.Group):
+        pass
+
+    factory = Mock(return_value=sentinel.decorator)
+
+    decorator = group_invoke_empty(
+        factory,
+        click.Group,
+        name,
+        CustomGroup,
+        invoke_without_command=invoke_without_command,
+        help="Custom help",
+    )
+
+    assert decorator is sentinel.decorator
+    factory.assert_called_once_with(
+        name,
+        CustomGroup,
+        invoke_without_command=invoke_without_command,
+        help="Custom help",
+    )
+
+
+def test_click_group_runs_without_subcommand_by_default(group_invoke_empty, runner):
+    def demo_group():
+        click.echo("group callback")
+
+    cli = group_invoke_empty(click.command, click.Group, demo_group)
+    reference = click.group(demo_group, invoke_without_command=True)
+
+    assert type(cli) is type(reference) is click.Group
+    assert cli.name == reference.name == "demo"
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, [])
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    assert result.output == "group callback\n"
+
+
+def test_rejects_decorating_a_command_twice(group_invoke_empty):
+    @click.command
+    def cli():
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(
+        TypeError, match="Attempted to convert a callback into a command twice"
+    ):
+        group_invoke_empty(click.command, click.Group, cli)
